failure_summary.description: Agents chose a salient associated fact or title instead of following explicit clue details and the requested entity target.
Bare lists of real people implicitly sought a shared jurisdiction or affiliation, but the list rule covers only fictional characters and shared works.
Answers were over-expanded by restoring wording already supplied or using a longer name than the expected unambiguous form.
A bare list of countries had a plausible collective answer, but the gold answer was one listed country and the prompt did not disambiguate the target.

patch.reasoning: The existing instructions already cover full-clue matching, target selection, and minimal answer forms, so those errors do not need duplicate rules. Extend the bare-list rule to real people to address the missing shared-jurisdiction or affiliation pattern.

edits.target: When a prompt consists only of a list of character names or roles, use context to identify their shared work or program if that is the implied target. Return the work or program, not the performers, unless the prompt asks for the cast.
edits.content: When a prompt consists only of a list of named people or roles, infer the shared relation most strongly supported by context and implied by the list. For fictional characters, this may be their shared work or program; for real people, it may be a shared state, country, institution, office, or affiliation. Return that shared target rather than an incidental relationship among the people or one listed person, and do not guess if context supports no common relation.
